title: Creation of Debt Retirement Fund Ordinance 1993

sections.shortTitle: Creation of Debt Retirement Fund Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

ORDINANCE, XXXVI 1993
ORDINANCE, XXXVI
1993
CREATION OF DEBT RETIREMENT FUND ORDINANCE, 1993
1. Short title, extent, application and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Creation of
Debt Retirement Fund Ordinance, 1993.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.
(3) It shall apply to all funds
generated from privatisation of State owned enterprises, banks and financial
institutions.
(4) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Creation of Debt Retirement Fund Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Definitions

ORDINANCE, XXXVI 1993
ORDINANCE, XXXVI
1993
CREATION OF DEBT RETIREMENT FUND ORDINANCE, 1993
2. Definitions.‑‑(1) In this Ordinance,
unelss there is anything repugnant to the subject or context,‑‑
(a) "net proceeds"
means the proceeds by privatisation of State‑owned enterprises, banks and
financial institutions after deducting expenses of privatisation and
liabilities, including shares of owners other than the Federal Government,
payable out of the proceeds of privatisation;
(b) "privatisation"
means the total or partial divestiture, disinvestment, sale of shares and
assets, alienation or transfer of ownership or management of State‑owned
enterprises, banks and financial institutions;
(c) "Privatisation
Commission" means the Commission set up by the Federal Government to undertake
privatisation of State‑owned enterprises, banks and financial
institutions; and
(d) "State‑owned
enterprise" means any company, corporation, organization, undertaking,
establishment or unit incorporated or operating within or outside Pakistan in
which the Federal Government has controlling shares or which is administered,
managed, controlled, or owned wholly or partially by the Federal Government.
(2) The words and expressions
used but not defined in this Ordinance shall have the same meanings as in the
Companies Ordinance, 1984 (XLVII of 1984). .

sections.shortTitle: Creation of Debt Retirement Fund Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Establishment of debt retirement fund

ORDINANCE, XXXVI 1993
ORDINANCE, XXXVI
1993
CREATION OF DEBT RETIREMENT FUND ORDINANCE, 1993
3. Establishment of Debt Retirement Fund.‑‑(1) On commencement of this
Ordinance, the Federal Government shall establish a Debt Retirement Fund,
within the Public Account of the Federation, to be financed by‑‑
(a) the total net proceeds by
the privatisation of State‑owned enterpirses, banks and financial
institutions; and
(b) all incomes generated
through privatisation of State‑owned enterprises, banks and financial
institutions.
(2) The amount of Debt
Retirement Fund shall not lapse at the end of financial year and shall, subject
to section 4, be available for utilisation at any time.

sections.shortTitle: Creation of Debt Retirement Fund Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Utilisation of debt retirement fund

ORDINANCE, XXXVI 1993
ORDINANCE, XXXVI
1993
CREATION OF DEBT RETIREMENT FUND ORDINANCE, 1993
4. Utilisation
of Debt Retirement Fund: ‑‑The Debt Retirement Fund shall be
utilised for retirement of domestic and foreign debts and for any other purpose
incidental thereto.

sections.shortTitle: Creation of Debt Retirement Fund Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Maintenance of accounts

ORDINANCE, XXXVI 1993
ORDINANCE, XXXVI
1993
CREATION OF DEBT RETIREMENT FUND ORDINANCE, 1993
5. Maintenance of accounts.‑‑The
accounts of the Debt Retirement Fund shall be maintained by the Ministry of
Finance and, audited by the Auditor‑General of Pakistan.

Power to make rules

1993
CREATION OF DEBT RETIREMENT FUND ORDINANCE, 1993
6. Power to make rules.‑‑The Federal
Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, make rules for
carrying out the purposes of this Ordinance.

Ordinance to override other laws

7. Ordinance to override other laws.‑‑The
provisions of this Ordinance shall have effect notwithstanding anything
contained in any other law for the time being in force or in any agreement
or contract or memorandum or articles of association.
